statements.statement: Patient has recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness (R42)
Patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease of native coronary arteries (I25.10)
Patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The monitoring was ordered to evaluate for potential arrhythmias or ischemic changes that may be contributing to these symptomatic episodes
The submitted clinical indication note documents these findings and supports the medical necessity of the service
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial is based on required precertification or prior authorization not being obtained before services were rendered
